It is issued by the excise department to be affixed on bottles, pouches and canes to prevent evasion of excise duty. It cannot, by any stretch, fall or be deemed as an excisable article. 24. Section 29 lays down the manner in which the excise duty can be levied. It provides that the Excise Commissioner can frame the rules and regulate the payment of excise duty. The State Government can direct that excise duty would be charged on any excisable article by notification.
